description: Active published grouped product on the store with an active in-stock child, plus as many add-on groups and personalizable attributes as the test fills in. KB: Product Types (Grouped); Configuring Product Add-ons; Adding Personalization Options to a Product.

quantityUsed.description: Highest quantity the test sets for this product in the cart

minAddOns.description: Add-on groups the test selects on this product (0 when it selects none)

minPersonalizableAttributes.description: Personalizable text attributes the test fills in (0 when none)

store.description: Store code the webstore under test serves (ZnodePortal.StoreCode)
